bias: 'Friday's liquidation was substantial, but after the washout we've just seen, blindly pressing shorts may be every bit as dangerous as trying to catch the falling knife.' ES finally ended its monthly one-time-framing higher (took out the Sept low 7569-7575 → 7558.25) while NQ traded into significant longer-term references (June low / 0.382 at 28232.75, near the 200-day). Both can produce a meaningful response — a back-test higher after ending monthly OTFU on ES, an inventory correction on NQ — but neither has repaired the technical damage. Monday is about the rotations within Friday's range, the reclaims buyers need to demonstrate control, and the failures that trigger another leg. 'The direction matters. The path we take to get there matters more.' Bigger moves develop outside Friday's range or on failed breaks of it.
